hero.title: About the Project
hero.intro: Understanding the need, purpose, and impact of Care@Home.

sections.heading: Background & Need
paragraphs: Europe is experiencing a rapid demographic shift. The population aged 65 and over is growing significantly and is expected to reach nearly 30% by 2050. At the same time, a large proportion of older adults live alone, increasing the risk of social isolation and delayed medical response.

Healthcare systems are under increasing pressure, with a projected shortage of millions of healthcare professionals in the coming years. Traditional care models are becoming difficult to sustain, especially for continuous monitoring and support at home.

sections.heading: The Problem
paragraphs: Existing monitoring solutions, such as wearables, often fail in real-life scenarios due to usability issues, limited adoption, and lack of scalability. Many systems are intrusive, require active user engagement, or do not integrate well into everyday life.
As a result, early signs of health deterioration frequently go unnoticed, leading to preventable hospitalizations and reduced quality of life for older adults.

sections.heading: Project Goal
paragraphs: Care@Home aims to develop a cutting-edge AI-based, contactless monitoring ecosystem that enables continuous, non-invasive observation of individuals in their home environments.
The system integrates IoT sensors, TinyML, and privacy-preserving technologies to detect assistance needs, monitor daily activities, and track vital signs without disrupting everyday life.

vision.heading: Vision
vision.text: Care@Home envisions a future where AI supports independent living by working seamlessly in the background, empowering older adults, supporting caregivers, and enabling timely, data-driven interventions without compromising privacy or dignity.

items.title: For Older Adults
items.text: Improved safety, independence, and quality of life through continuous, unobtrusive monitoring.

items.title: For Caregivers & Families
items.text: Peace of mind and reduced burden through real-time insights and early alerts.

items.title: For Healthcare Systems
items.text: Reduced workload and costs by enabling preventive care and minimizing unnecessary hospitalizations.

items.title: For Society
items.text: Scalable, ethical AI solutions that address demographic challenges and support sustainable healthcare systems.
